prompt.text:
TrackType: Music, VocalType: Instrumental, 120 BPM, D minor with subtle Dorian color.

High-intensity video game combat soundtrack inspired by the relentless aggression, heavy distortion and forward momentum of the DOOM game soundtrack, but with a distinctly organic forest identity.

A deep, punchy four-on-the-floor bass drum provides the constant driving pulse throughout the entire track. Strong quarter-note hits in every bar, with occasional double-hit accents and syncopation. The kick should have the weight and precision of a powerful electronic club kick, but only as the rhythmic foundation. Massive low war toms, frame drums and resonant hand drums play fast, energetic acoustic patterns around it with hard transient impact and large natural reverb.

Use the dense distorted energy of a modern heavy action-game soundtrack while keeping the instrumentation predominantly organic. Distortion should feel rough, physical and amplified rather than synthetic.

Create the forest character through instrumental textures. High bowed strings and noisy violin textures suggest wind through trees. Fluttering strings and brushed percussion suggest moving leaves. Harsh short violin, cello and muted brass calls evoke ravens and owls. Flowing tremolo strings, rolling hand percussion and resonant bowed textures suggest moving water.

Keep these forest-like textures clearly present throughout the full-intensity arrangement. They must coexist with the driving rhythm, not appear as a separate ambient section.

Dense, raw, primal, energetic and slightly mysterious, but not excessively dark. Tight punchy percussion, powerful low end, large natural reverb, long organic echoes and wide spatial depth.

No synth bass, no electronic basslines, no sequenced synth pulses, no arpeggiators, no digital leads, no electronic risers, no industrial drones, no dark techno atmosphere, no EDM arrangement, no dreamy pads, no vocals.

**Maximum rhythmic energy from beat one to the final beat. No intro, no atmospheric opening, no buildup, no crescendo, no gradual layering, no breakdown, no calm section, no sparse passage, no final fade. Seamless continuous gameplay loop.**

Dark forest dawn background music built around powerful, driving low percussion. Continuous rhythmic momentum from deep toms, large frame drums and heavy resonant hand drums, with strong pulse, dense repeating patterns, syncopated accents and firm low-end impact. Energetic cinematic and propulsive.

A clearly audible forest soundscape is the major part of the track and extremely prominent: strong wind through trees, constant rustling leaves, moving branches, distant crows and ravens, owl and eagle-owl calls, and a flowing woodland stream. These natural sounds should remain present throughout the track and occupy noticeable space in the mix.

Very sparse dark harmony underneath: muted low cello, restrained low wooden flute and soft but very distorted pads. Minimal melody, no bright or cheerful lead instrument.

Large natural reverb, long atmospheric tails, soft delay and wide spatial depth. Earthy, cold, mysterious, slightly ominous and melancholic.

No techno, no EDM drums, no kick-drum pattern, no synth bass, no arpeggiators, no bright mallets, no marimba, no vocals, no heroic melody. Loop-friendly, immediate rhythmic start, no long intro, no final fade.
